about_the_game:
The dwindling ranks of the remaining U.S. military force are being replenished in a desperate experiment: convicts are recruited and fully lobotomized via mind‑altering technology.

Starting a government subsidised mercenary company, you must take on contracts from the military and use a state-provided arsenal of lobotomized humans and remotely controlled vehicles to rid America of the mutant pestilence one contract at a time.

Key Features

  • Horrifying Infantry gameplay
    Navigate the dark and unsettling environments of indoor facilities having to face hordes of foul creatures. Always outnumbered, solely relying on skill and equipment to complete missions.

  • Action-packed Vehicle combat
    Blast away at the more intelligent mutants using all sorts of vehicles from basic modified WW2 era tanks to advanced, newly designed anti-mutant fighting vehicles with a fully simulated armour penetration and internal component system, making combat feel grounded.

  • Dynamic Progression and a Huge arsenal
    When completing contracts and side missions, earn weapons, gear, and augmentations through mission rewards and gain access to new Mutant Hunter and vehicle variants as your company becomes more recognised by the military industrial complex.

  • Non-Linear Open-Map Exploration
    Explore interlinked zones in each contract mission at your own pace. Uncover side‑quests, hidden lore.

  • Deep Atmospheric Lore
    Environmental storytelling reveals the backstory behind the mutations and the human conspiracy at the heart of the chaos.

Why You’ll Want to Play

  • Immerse yourself in the life of owning a Mutant Hunting private military company in the post-apocalypse.

  • Expand your combat loadout and unlock upgrades that suit your playstyle as you work your way up the ladder of importance in remnant US society..

  • Piece together the darker implications behind the world's collapse: were mutations engineered? Who’s really controlling the Mutants?

short_description: As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control. Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

English*, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Ukrainian, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
